item.title: El-Sayed admits 'mistake' months after synagogue attack remark
item.description:
Michigan Democratic Senate nominee Abdul El-Sayed apologized Saturday to Jewish Democrats for a March remark, "hurt people hurt people," that he made after a targeted attack on a synagogue near Detroit. Speaking in Lansing, El-Sayed said he should have simply condemned the attack. He still declined to disavow streamer Hasan Piker, whose Israel-related comments have drawn criticism.
